trust_decision.summary: Whether a template string is user-authored config (may use cmd/readFile/stat/glob/env) or runtime-composed text (must not); at the pinned commit there is no distinction: every render, including the path segment's re-render of pt.Path built from raw folder names, uses the single full func map.

landing_point.why: Advisory title names the path segment; setStyle re-renders the composed pt.Path (folder names spliced in by colorizePath) as a template.

fix_sites.entry_point: oh-my-posh print primary/right/transient (path segment Enabled -> setStyle)
fix_sites.module_kind: segment (the only behavioural switch to the restricted renderer)
core template func-map builder (split into trusted / restricted; sprig env/expandenv also removed from restricted)
parsed-template cache key (adds trust level so a trusted parse is never reused for an untrusted render)
parse with func map chosen by trust level
public render API split into RenderTrusted / RenderUntrusted

fix_sites.entry_point: segment option values rendered as templates (api keys, urls)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: No second template implementation: text/template is imported only in src/template/func_map.go:6 and src/template/render.go; the rest of the fix is renames plus the core func-map/cache split in src/template.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The .Env.X rewrite to (call .Getenv) is not a func-map entry and only reads/display environment values (no command execution), so a solver can argue it is outside a 'command execution' advisory; the parse cache looks like a performance detail unrelated to security.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Config values spliced into pt.Path before the re-render (home_icon, mapped_locations values, folder_format/edge formats, folder_separator) legitimately contain templates that must still render; an over-broad fix that drops the setStyle render or escapes all of pt.Path breaks them, and the trusted render of option templates (cmd in segment templates, status_template, mapped_location keys) must keep working.

O6_input_shapes: folder name with {{ cmd ... }} under Full/Short style (via colorizePath of all folders)
last folder name under FolderType style
any of the style builders feeding setStyle (agnoster, mixed, letter, unique, fish, powerlevel) via the single render at src/segments/path.go:285

O7_producer.where: src/template/render.go:55-75 (templateCacheKey) and src/template/render.go:85-101 (parsedTemplates keyed without trust level, parsed with funcMap() at :95)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: In the restricted renderer, patchTemplate still rewrites .Env.NAME into (call .Getenv "NAME") on the context, so a folder named {{ .Env.SECRET }} still reads the environment even though the fix removes env/expandenv from untrusted renders.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Not a func-map entry and not command execution; looks like a neighbouring display feature, and the context's Getenv is set for every render at src/template/render.go:28.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: src/template package, 2 files away from the landing point in src/segments

O8_uncovered_routes.route: In the restricted renderer, the context still exposes the full .Segments cross-segment data (rewritten to .Segments.MustGet) to folder-name template text.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Read-only data already shown in the prompt; not an OS-touching function.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Path.Format(inputPath) (called from user templates with git RelativeDir) re-rendering its colorized output like setStyle does.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Format builds the same colorizePath output as setStyle; a maintainer wanting icons/formats with templates to resolve would add the same 'resolve all templates' line.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Re-rendering the colour picked by background_templates/foreground_templates (which can embed segment data like a branch name) through color ResolveTemplate.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: ResolveTemplate already exists for terminal_background (src/color/colors.go:154-169); applying it to segment colours is a natural feature extension.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Splicing the branch name into branch_template text before rendering instead of passing it as context.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Branch-template helpers commonly build strings with fmt.Sprintf; same second-order shape as pt.Path.

O9_family: template injection (second-order: runtime data re-rendered as a template) leading to command execution (CWE-1336/CWE-94)

O10_build.project_tests: src/segments/path_unix_test.go and src/segments/path_windows_test.go (testFullAndFolderPathCases), src/template/*_test.go (cmd_test.go, text_test.go, files_test.go); mock environment, no network

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Escape or strip '{{' from folder names in the path segment, or delete the setStyle re-render (breaks templated home_icon/mapped_locations values), without touching the func map, .Env rewrite or parse cache.

out_of_scope_notes: Config files themselves (including remote/URL configs) are treated as trusted by the fix; whether a config can come from an untrusted location was not examined.
Segment cache restore (src/config/segment.go:445-500) decodes writer data from disk; it is rendered as context, not as template text, so it was not pursued.
